findings.problem: The bare 'search_path' match flags any migration with a SECURITY DEFINER function (SET search_path = pg_catalog, ...): 65/148 upstream migrations, 7 of the last 15, none of which touch the archive. Reproduced with the real 20261101010000_capability_hub_fractional_usage.sql after the pin -> 'changed the telegram_archive contract', exit 1. Fails closed, but makes check-all red for every milestone about every second upstream migration and invites blind pin bumps
findings.required_improvement: backlog: drop the bare search_path match and record unqualified names as a shortcut in SOURCE.md, or match only statement-level search_path that names telegram_archive/capability_hub; add a false-positive case (function with SET search_path = pg_catalog, public) expecting exit 0

findings.problem: Unquoted word splitting and git's C-quoting of non-ASCII names: an archive rename in '20270101 next.sql' or '20270101_архив.sql' -> 'no telegram_archive migration changes', exit 0. Upstream names are <timestamp>_<snake_case>.sql today
findings.required_improvement: backlog: replace the loop with hits=$(git -C "$upstream" -c core.quotePath=false diff --name-only -G '<regex>' "$commit" "$ref" -- supabase/migrations) (verified on the same repos; -4 lines)

findings.problem: Quoted or mixed-case identifiers pass: alter table "capability_hub"."connections" drop column "metadata" (supabase db diff style) and ALTER TABLE Capability_Hub.Connections ... -> exit 0. Upstream uses unquoted lower case today
